item.text: The reference appears to have a flared conical base and a cylindrical stem with rounded longitudinal flutes. I’ll build it along world Z with the base at the lower end. The [live CAD view](http://127.0.0.1:8771/#part.FCStd) is available.
The first preview matches the overall proportions. The reference also shows a slight taper near the stem’s base; I’ll add that so the flute ends narrow smoothly into the stem.
